title: ID0419947-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R5 313059216001] Missing Energy Consumption - meterstop = 0
description:
Reported Issue: Post a supply loss event at Springs junction the charger had a
successful charge for an hour, the customer he confirmed that he
definitely got a charge. The session data did not capture the
charging session - there was no energy consumed and the
customer was not charged a for transaction .

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0419947-DC/Si-D/NZ-[Y2 / R5 313059216001] CRM:02682000053
additional_info.body:
Hi Liz,
Hope this email finds you well.
After analyzing the logs and reviewing the charger status in our Siemens backend, we've identified that the charger appears to be offline & there is no metering equipment detected on the DC outlets as per the charger configuration.
Could you please confirm if the charger was intentionally turned off, and if so, would it be possible to turn it back on?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

Hi Liz,
Thank you for your patience. Our team is working on resolving this issue in an upcoming firmware version. However, please note:
Currently, there is no specific timeline in which firmware version it will be fixed.
This issue only occurs when there is a power loss during an active charging session
Since the development team is already working on the solution, and no immediate actions are required from either side, I suggest we close this ticket.
Keeping the ticket open would not serve any practical purpose at this time. Please let me know if you agree to close this ticket
